about_the_game:
Glinium is a shooter entirely handcrafted from plasticine and brought into 3D using photogrammetry. Explore surreal corridors and architecture unlike anything in our reality, solve puzzles, battle creatures that defy description — and uncover the world’s deepest secret.

🎭 A world made of plasticine, scanned from real handmade models

🔫 Old-school shooter mechanics filtered through a dreamlike, analog reality

🎨 Stop-motion-inspired visuals with clay imperfections

🧩 Puzzles, secrets, and oddities all over the way

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570 (4 GB VRAM, Vulkan support required)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL-compatible sound device
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Requires 64-bit OS with Vulkan support. Some distros may need additional libraries (e.g. libxcb, libpulse).
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT or higher (Vulkan)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL-compatible sound device
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for Steam Deck. Native Linux build tested on Proton and SteamOS 3.0. Vulkan is required for full visual fidelity and performance.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12.0 Monterey
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Apple M1 GPU or Intel Iris Plus Graphics 645
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Mac-compatible sound hardware
  • Additional Notes: Tested on Apple Silicon via native and Rosetta builds. Performance may vary on older Intel Macs. SSD recommended.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13.0 Ventura or later
  • Processor: Apple M2 or Intel Core i7 (6-core or better)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 560X
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Mac-compatible sound hardware
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for Apple Silicon. High-res assets and post-processing effects benefit from newer GPUs and more RAM.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Game uses stylized scanned assets and high-res textures.SSD recommended for faster loading times.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT or higher
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible, surround sound support preferred
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Best experienced on systems with SSD storage and mid-to-high-end GPUs due to photogrammetry-based visuals and dynamic post-processing.
